model.title: BANNED in Latin America Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. John Curtis (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would require the Secretary of State to develop and submit to Congress a strategy for addressing Iranian and Hezbollah activities and influence operations across Latin America.
